The noble family I am serving is on a par with\nthe Elf royal family and\ntheir collateral relatives, the Lufenas.
After the cataclysm, the family left Eldenbaum and\nsettled here. They have been helping impoverished\npeople regardless of race for a long time.
They deserve respect and never incur hatred...\nWhy did our young master have to go through\nthis kind of...
Oh, adventurer! I can never thank you enough\nfor saving our young master...
Yes. Since then, we employed more bodyguards and\nset up more traps to prepare for monster attacks.
We owe everything to you, merchant and bodyguard.\nThank you.
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
?! Um, excuse me. Are you Straye...?\nOh! Thank gods, the creators of this world!\nI must thank you for my good fortune...
Oh, I'm sorry. My name is Larflon.\nAre you perhaps... a merchant and bodyguard?
Yes. What's the matter with you?
Um, our young master Marelli has been kidnapped\nby monsters and...
I chased the monsters but lost sight of them...\nSo, I'm at a loss here...
I believe it is a fate that we met here.\nCould you please save Marelli from them?\nPlease... I beg of you...
I don't have time for that.
Leave it to me!
Just leave it to me! This adv... Ahem!\nHe is one of my strongest bodyguards.\nI'm sure we can find and save your young master!
Oh...! Thank you...!\nThank you so much...!
Pelulu must have smelled the money...\nShe moved the conversation forward alone...

Right?

And she's acting like my employer or something...
Did you get it? I'll wait for you with him and\npray for your safety.
You can't believe she's not coming...\nWell, you don't have much time.\nYou must save the young master at once...
Butler!
Oh! Young master!! You're safe...\nThank you! Thank you...!\nI can't thank you enough and... Oh?
It's very rare to see a female Elf knight but...\nThe crest on your clothes... Y-You're...
O-Oh dear!\nI forgot to do something really important.\nBalft, we have to go back right now.
Y-Yea, right!
We're sorry. See you...
?? Is my memory wrong?\nThen, I must apologize to her...\nYes, please tell her that I'm deeply sorry.
Yes? Tecaca...? A Cule merchant ?\nYes, I saw him.
He was at the swamp ahead of here.\nHe's still there I think.
Did you hear that? We'll go to the swamp, alright?\n...Wanna take a rest!? Not a chance!\nWe must go right now!!
Thanks, adventurer!
Oh, it's you! I'm sorry I was lost.\nThis world is so different from our world.
I don't even remember where the wormhole is...\nCould you guide me to the city?
